title: Test chart for copying lathes with horizontal spindle-lathes with swing over bed upto 500 mm and distance between centres up to 1500 mm
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10190) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Test chart for copying lathes with horizontal spindle-lathes with swing over bed upto 500 mm and distance between centres up to 1500 mm.
clause_3_terminology: Test chart for copying lathes with horizontal spindle
lathes with swing over bed upto 500 mm and distance between centres up to 1500 mm

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
